title: Pairing-independent Göttsche–Schroeter invariants for h-transverse polygons in arbitrary genus
author: Mével, Gurvan
work: Combinatorial Göttsche-Schroeter invariants in any genus

primary_locator.required_new_core: exact h-transverse polygon, genus/order/pairing, floor diagram/marked multiplicity and automorphism conventions; complete three-unmarked-label case partition and local quantum-integer contribution equalities

difficulty_reason: The author constructs a partition of marked floor diagrams and proves equality of refined multiplicity sums for every local three-label configuration, including diagram modifications and automorphism multiplicities. The complete case partition and quantum-integer identities establish arbitrary-genus invariance, not a direct application of genus-zero invariance.
